{{Locations|Rock Homeworlds|LRSmap=ship|unique=true}}


This is the [[The Rock Cruiser|Rock Cruiser]] ship unlocking event. <span style="color:grey">(the ship can also be unlocked by winning the game with the Slug Cruiser)</span>
----


''You are immediately messaged by an imposing looking Rock war vessel, "You're the ship off to 'save the Federation,' aren't you? And you expect to survive with that hunk of junk?"''
# "We're going to save them or die trying."
#* ''"The latter being more likely. Still... we can potentially help you and your precious fleet, but you'll need to prove yourself first. Meet us at these coordinates." They jump away.''
#** A [[#Sun Quest Marker|'''quest marker''']] is added to your map.
# "We're strong enough to destroy you!"
#* ''"One ship is not the same as a fleet, but at least you've got some fire. Meet us at these coordinates if you want to prove to us that the Federation is worth saving." They jump away.''
#** A [[#Sun Quest Marker|'''quest marker''']] is added to your map.
# Ignore them.
#* ''"Heh. Like I expected. If the Federation is as weak as you it deserves to fall." They jump away without another word.''
#** Nothing happens.


==Sun Quest Marker==
[[File:Quest_at_hazard_beacon_with_ship.png|Quest event near Red Giant Star|thumb|right]]
:{{Long-Ranged Scanners info|shipdetected=ship+redgiant}}

''You arrive at the coordinates given and find yourself dangerously close to an M-class star! The other ship messages you, "Let's see how long your puny ship can handle this heat! Prepare for a challenge!"''
* Fight the [[Rock_Ships#Rock_Assault_(Elite)|Rock Assault (Elite) ship]]. &nbsp;<!-- ship name="ROCK_UNLOCK2" (events_ships.xml) --><span style="color:grey">(ship starts to escape with 32 seconds countdown timer)</span>
** ''The Rock ship starts to power up their FTL drive. If we're going to earn their trust we must endure the heat for as long as they can!''
*** {{Winning|gotaway=true|As they jump away they relay coordinates to your navigation system. They must mean for you to follow them!}}
**** Another [[#Shipyard Quest Marker|'''quest marker''']] is added to your map.
*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|Their ship breaks apart and you feel a twinge of guilt. Perhaps they could have helped the Federation if this had gone another way. You scrap what you can and prepare to jump out of the heat.}}
**** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
*** {{Winning|deadCrew=true|Their ship goes quiet and you feel a twinge of guilt. Perhaps they could have helped the Federation if this had gone another way. You scrap what you can and prepare to jump out of the heat.}}
**** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].


==Shipyard Quest Marker==
:{{Long-Ranged Scanners info|shipdetected=ship}}
''You arrive at a massive Rockman shipyard and notice the ship that had just tried to kill you is docked and already being repaired. "Well fought! I must say I did not expect you to survive."''
* ''I am convinced of your strength and pledge to assist your cause. We'll immediately send an advanced cruiser to the Federation fleet and we will prepare our warships to move out.''
** You unlock the [[The Rock Cruiser|Rock Cruiser]].
*** ''"Now that that's taken care of, let us patch up your hull. Maybe we can improve its armor plating while we're at it."''
**** You receive <span style="color:limegreen">Rock Plating</span> [[Augmentations#Titanium_System_Casing|augmentation]] and your ship receives <span style="color:limegreen">29 repairs</span>.

==Trivia==
This event is called "ROCK_UNLOCK" in the datafiles.
